# Slivochnaya cooked sausage

A gentle creamy profile with a fully disclosed ingredient list.

- Net weight: 400 g
- Halal verified
- Without nitrite

## Ingredients

Chicken thigh fillet, drinking water, beef, chicken fillet, poultry skin, beef fat, milk protein, whey protein, milk powder, chicken egg melange, fruit and spice extracts (pomelo, lemon, black and white pepper blend), salt, glucose, spice extracts (black pepper, nutmeg, ginger), cream-type flavouring, yeast extract (brewer's yeast), citrus extracts (lemon, lime, orange, pomelo), table salt, maltodextrin, corn starch, flavouring.

**Allergens:** Milk, eggs

## Nutrition per 100 g

- kcal: 174
- protein: 14.4 g
- fat: 12.2 g
- carbohydrate: 0.7 g

Calculated estimate per 100 g of raw recipe; not a laboratory value.
